# Post

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Post`](gmeow-Post.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Post>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)

A seat or position that exists independently of who currently holds it — the CFO chair is not the person now in it. A [`Post`](gmeow-Post.md) bundles a [`gmeow:Role`](gmeow-Role.md) within a specific [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md), enabling 'vacant post' and 'succession in a post' queries.
